calibration_notes: Single-arm CRS pickup and JIG placement with physical contact and HugWBC. This release exposes only the selected pickup/load task.

crs_load_jig.pinch_geometry_evidence: left_speedup_v1/cad_reversed_jaw_endpoints_v2.json: thickness-centered reversed LEFT jawface; first moving innerpad touch +0.0721787rad, fixed innerpad gap100um. Jaw0 is a closure command, not a claimed reachable geometric state. New bilateral capture remains unobserved.

open_cleaner_cover.title: Remove cleaner lid and park on support

jig_insert_cleaner.title: Grasp loaded JIG and insert into cleaner

jig_extract_cleaner.title: Extract washed JIG and place on staging table

crs_final_place.title: Grasp cleaned CRS and place in final cart slot
crs_final_place.pinch_geometry_evidence: Raw authored jaw triangle/CRS sector clipping: crs_flat_pinch_depth_search.json, 82.5deg upper-face grasp, finger depth .175m, first moving contact -0.03360rad; expected physical contact near [-.08,-.01]rad (diagnostic only, not acceptance rule). Same face grasp in task1 physically acquired near -.04565rad then slipped; task5 grasp stability remains unverified. task5_jaw_aperture_audit.json: open -.4rad permits sampled normal approach without intersections in raw JIG frame, original guide and full robot meshes. Source raw frame provenance original_jig_frame_raw.json; original slots original_jig_slot_guides.json. No geometry/material/torque/closed gate change. task5_deep82_close_cad.json: q=-.4 to 0 closure sweep has no non-target intersections; first sampled intended CRS intersection at -.034rad.

jig_slots.note: The 10 mm guide slots are real authored meshes whose collision schemas were absent. Session collision restoration and actual PhysX settling are required; the settled pose is a geometric estimate, not a measured success.

source.axis_conversion: ROS +Z forward,+Y down -> Isaac +X forward,+Z up
source.calibration_scope: Existing repository calibration; physical device serial and calibration capture provenance are unavailable.
source.clipping_rationale: Existing D435 profile uses a 60mm near plane to clear the embedded head render mesh; no optical-center remount.
source.output_scope: Uniform resize plus center crop of the repository 640x480 calibration, not a separately measured 1280x720 hardware stream.
